sources.label: My Morphe patches for the apps I use, in one source for Morphe Manager.
sources.author: Noam
patch_list: Download photos
Adds a Download button to the photo viewer that saves the photo to Pictures/Geocaching.
Extra map layers
Street (OpenStreetMap), Satellite and Hybrid (Esri) and Terrain (OpenTopoMap) layers in the map type picker, no keys needed.
Faster map reloads after switching tabs
Coming back to the Map tab shows the map as you left it right away while it redraws underneath.
Hide Upgrade badges
Removes the Upgrade badge from the map and the Premium badge from the Trails map layer.
Keep map in place after closing a cache
Coming back to the map from a cache leaves it where it was instead of moving it and loading again.
Local lists
Lists kept on the device: the Lists tab opens without Premium, Create a List makes them there, and Add to list saves the cache into the list you pick so it opens offline.
Map search from geocaching.com
Map caches come from geocaching.com's search the way c:geo gets them, without the app's cap and with every map filter applied.
Map without a Google key
Uses the app's built-in MapLibre map instead of Google Maps, so no Google Maps key is needed.
Native description viewer
Shows cache descriptions in one native viewer with their formatting, images, tables and buttons, instead of the Web View and Text View tabs.
Offline caches
Keeps every cache the map shows (the 6000 most recent) and every cache you open, with its images (the 300 most recent), on the device, so the map and the caches work without a connection.
One sign-in for app and website
Signing in to the app with username and password also signs in to geocaching.com, which the website features need. The password is kept encrypted with the Android Keystore.
Open description links in the app
Checker links and buttons (GeoCheck, Certitude...) and other description links open in a page inside the app instead of the browser.
Unlock Experimental features
Opens Experimental features in Settings without Premium and keeps its toggles on after the app restarts.
Unlock Finds and Hides sorting
Every sort option in Finds and Hides works without Premium.
Unlock map filters
Opens the map filter button and every filter option, including Fill in your D/T grid, without Premium. The geocaching.com map search applies them.
Unlock Premium caches
Opens the caches the app locks behind Premium by loading them from geocaching.com, the way c:geo does, so they show what the website shows your account.
Unlock Statistics
Statistics (D/T grid, averages, streaks) worked out from your own finds, opened from the profile without Premium and without the Go Premium line under it.
Unlock Templates
Log Templates kept on the device, opened from Settings and from the Templates button when you log a cache, without Premium.

patch_list: Enable Developer Tools and Feature Flags
Exposes the internal Debug Menu in Settings and provides selectors for LaunchDarkly feature flags, Remote Config controls, and remaining membership gates.
Local Premium

OpenStreetMap Drop-in Replacement
Replaces Google Maps with OpenStreetMap (MapLibre vector engine) and adds in-app OpenStreetMap style switching and custom URL configuration to Map settings.
Remove Lists
Removes the Lists option from the bottom navigation bar.
Remove Shop
Removes the Shop Geocaching promotional section and link from the Profile screen.
Remove Tracking and Analytics

Unlock Cache Filter and Sorting Tools
Unlocks advanced cache search filters and sorting options without prompting for Geocaching Premium.
Unlock Experimental Features
Unlocks beta and experimental features in Settings without Geocaching Premium.
Unlock Templates
Unlocks geocache log templates, allowing creating, editing, and applying custom log templates without Geocaching Premium.
